Name: ChiChi's Silly Sanrio Scarecrows
Author: chichisribbons
Description:
♡ ChiChi's Silly Sanrio Scarecrow Mod
featuring the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures Mod!
[/url]﻿
♡ qualities and traits:
⇢ contains 13 different sanrio characters
⇢ keroppi, pompom, my melody, kuromi, hello kitty, gudetama, badtz maru, kiki, lala, marron cream, monkichi, winkipinki, cheery chums
⇢ I'm always open to adding more characters based on comments and endorsements

♡ this mod is stylized
⇢ not meant to actually look like sanrio characters
⇢ comments calling my mod ugly or not true to sanrio will be removed
⇢ characters are chonky and maybe not color accurate
⇢ goes well with blue grass recolor and other pastel mods
⇢ compatible with any other alternative texture and content patcher scarecrow mods, too!
